Initial release of Landscaping Business Video.

- Launches AI-powered video creation designed for landscaping marketing.
- Supports before-and-after project showcases, seasonal promotions, hardscape portfolios, commercial contract pitches, and neighborhood-targeted social ads.
- Built for a wide range of landscape businesses: solo operators, design-build firms, commercial maintenance, HOA vendors, irrigation, tree services, hardscape installers, and marketing agencies.
- Allows users to generate professional marketing videos quickly by simply describing the project, style, and target audience—no need for on-site photographers or crew interruptions.
- Facilitates ongoing content generation to improve lead flow, portfolio visibility, and digital presence across social and local platforms.
